label: main season
summary: The unverified national database record of a past accident inside the area is indirect evidence (E1, reliability class 6), but the national criteria make it a clearance target after the first visit. Technical survey is not available in this programme. E2 is also indirect and weak, and does not independently reach the follow-up threshold after only one visit. The clearance recommendation passes the rule check.
flags: The database entry has no date or other detail, and its location has not been checked on the ground; the national criteria nevertheless require an intrusive check before release.
E2 is a second-hand, unlocated report; it has not yet had two visits for follow-up under the criteria.
The zone survey flag and rank are for visit prioritisation, not evidence.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E1.

E1.quote: The national mine action database records one or more past landmine accidents inside this area.
E1.note: Unchecked database record with no date or ground-checked location is indirect evidence; its reliability is unassessed.

E2.quote: A newcomer to the vereda said neighbours told them that an animal was killed by a mine somewhere in the area some years ago.
E2.note: This is an unlocated, second-hand report from a source who cannot establish that the neighbours were first-hand witnesses, so it suggests possible EO but does not confirm it.
